inputs.name: file
inputs.purpose: CHESS input file or PSE template (.xlsx or .csv)

inputs.name: config
inputs.purpose: Config form: CHESS configuration (outfolder, project_name, struc_id, case_name, workflow, storm_db or region/sp_ID)

inputs.name: action
inputs.purpose: Parse form: read a run file name back into storm database, workflow and file type

inputs.name: file_name
inputs.purpose: Parse form: run file name, with or without its folder

inputs.name: project_name
inputs.purpose: Outfolder form: project name (project level paths only)

inputs.name: pse
inputs.purpose: Outfolder form: PSE name (config.struc_id), adds pse_dir

inputs.name: alt
inputs.purpose: Outfolder form: alternative name (config.case_name), adds alt_dir

inputs.name: workflow
inputs.purpose: Outfolder form: workflow number 1 PROS-RB, 2 DET, 3 LCS, 4 PROS-FB (give with db)

inputs.name: db
inputs.purpose: Outfolder form: storm database name (a number is used as its digits)
